name: Break down the right
engine: Win it cleanly at the back, then break down the right: the first forward ball is free, clean wins need 3, and edges add up for the whole attack.
about: Found by the hunt with Guessing and Invites the pass banned (the second family). A clean win on defence gives the attack it starts +1, and in that attack edges add up instead of only the biggest counting (Defence into attack, captain Rodri). If the attack starts from a ball you won, forward passes, long balls and runs need a margin of 3 for a clean win, and the first of them does not use up a decision (Break at once). Porro and Yamal on the same flank turn a half win on a run or overlap into a clean win (Same side), and Porro's overlap is free and leaves a gap worth +2 (Overlaps). With two runners in midfield (Fabián and Olmo) you can wait at the edge of their box for one to arrive late (Runners from deep), at the price of +1 to their midfield. Behind it, a tackle that loses outside your box becomes a foul and a booking instead of a way through (Takes one for the team). It keeps menus real: 50.9% of menus are real choices, against 44% with no build.
decisions: Defend for a clean win, not a safe half win: a clean win starts the break with +1 and edges that add up.
On the break, go forward at once: the first forward ball costs no decision and needs 3, not 4.
At the edge of their box, wait for the late runner or go round with Porro: both get better with the break's stacked edges.
